items.duty_text: The department shall continuously consult with the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to identify and evaluate new surfacing materials not previously used for department playgrounds or athletic fields.

The department shall assess reasonably available information on new surfacing materials to determine whether they are appropriate for recreational activities in parks and meet applicable safety and health standards.
The department shall assess reasonably available information concerning health and safety risks, environmental studies, and alternative surfaces and technologies, including natural surfacing.
The department shall use best efforts to locate all pertinent sources of information on any surfacing material under evaluation.

items.duty_text: The department shall continuously consult with the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene to identify and evaluate new surfacing materials not previously used for department playgrounds or athletic fields.
